text.en: Ainu possesses two reflexive prefixes meaning 'oneself (acc/dat)': *yay-* and *si-* ⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--ainu-has-two-reflexive-prefixes-meaning-oneself-acc⟧. When transitive subject and object are coreferential, reflexivization is marked by the reflexive prefixes *yay-* or *si-* rather than by combinations of personal affixes ⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--when-transitive-subject-and-object-are-coreferential-reflexivization⟧. Reflexive actions in which the subject and direct or indirect object are coreferential are expressed by verbs prefixed with *yai-* ⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--reflexive-actions-where-the-subject-and-direct-indirect⟧. In Shizunai Ainu, the prefix *yay-* derives reflexive expressions where the subject and object of the verb are coreferential ⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--yay-reflexive-coreference-shizunai⟧. Attached to verbs, *yai-* expresses the reflexive meanings 'to oneself' or 'oneself', although it frequently yields a middle-voice meaning ⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--attached-to-verbs-yai-expresses-reflexive-meanings-to⟧. When prefixed to a monotransitive verb, reflexive *yay-* or reciprocal *'u-* fulfills the object role and typically turns the verb into an intransitive verb ⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--when-prefixed-to-a-transitive-verb-that-takes⟧. Personal affixes switch from transitive to intransitive forms when *yay-* derives an intransitive verb from a transitive one ⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--personal-affixes-switch-from-transitive-to-intransitive-forms⟧. In Saru Ainu, *yay-* is used not only for direct actions upon oneself, but also for quasi-directed actions such as commanding one's own companions ⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--the-reflexive-prefix-yay-can-be-used-not⟧.
text.ja: アイヌ語には「自分を（対格・与格）」を意味する再帰接頭辞として *yay-* と *si-* の二つの形式が存在する⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--ainu-has-two-reflexive-prefixes-meaning-oneself-acc⟧。他動詞の主格と目的格が同一人称となる再帰形では、人称接辞の組み合わせではなく再帰接辞 *yay-* または *si-* が用いられる⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--when-transitive-subject-and-object-are-coreferential-reflexivization⟧。主語と直接目的語または間接目的語が同一である再帰的動作は、接頭辞 *yai-* を冠した再帰動詞によって表される⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--reflexive-actions-where-the-subject-and-direct-indirect⟧。静内アイヌ語において、接頭辞 *yay-* は動詞の主語と目的語が同一指示的である再帰表現を派生させる⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--yay-reflexive-coreference-shizunai⟧。動詞に付く *yai-* は「自身に」や「自身を」という再帰的意味を表すが、中相の意味になることも多い⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--attached-to-verbs-yai-expresses-reflexive-meanings-to⟧。単一の目的語をとる他動詞に接頭した場合、再帰の *yay-* または相互の *'u-* は目的語の役割を果たし、通常はその動詞を自動詞へと変化させる⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--when-prefixed-to-a-transitive-verb-that-takes⟧。再帰接頭辞 *yay-* が他動詞から対応する自動詞を派生させるとき、人称接辞は他動詞用から自動詞用へと変化する⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--personal-affixes-switch-from-transitive-to-intransitive-forms⟧。沙流アイヌ語において、再帰接頭辞 *yay-* は自分自身に対する直接的な行為だけでなく、自分の仲間に命令するような準ずる行為にも用いられる⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--the-reflexive-prefix-yay-can-be-used-not⟧。

text.en: The reflexive prefixes *yay-* and *si-* belong to derivation rather than inflection, as they cannot attach freely to any verb or locational noun ⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--the-reflexive-prefixes-yay-and-si-belong-to⟧. The prefix *yay-* has a primary reflexive function along with reflexive-possessive, autocausative, and occasionally anticausative functions ⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--the-prefix-yay-has-a-primary-reflexive-function⟧. When attached to nouns, *yai-* expresses 'mere/ordinary', 'only one / one's own only', and 'one's own' ⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--attached-to-nouns-yai-expresses-mere-ordinary-1⟧. Both *yay-* and *si-* can attach as possessors to category 1 locative nouns and to incorporated body part nouns ⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--both-reflexive-prefixes-yay-and-si-can-attach⟧. Phonologically, *yai-ewen* contracts to *yayewen* ⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--the-combination-yai-ewen-contracts-to-yayewen⟧, *yai-omap* contracts to *yayómap* ⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--the-combination-yai-omap-contracts-to-yay-map⟧, and *yai-shitoma* contracts to *yashtoma* ⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--the-form-yai-shitoma-contracts-to-yashtoma⟧. In Shizunai Ainu, some verb forms prefixed with *yay-* are completely lexicalized, such that their reflexive origin is evident only through etymological analysis, as in *yaynu* 'think' from *nu* 'listen' and *yaytura* 'be alone' from *tura* 'join' ⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--lexicalized-yay-verbs-shizunai⟧. Furthermore, the adjunct-reducing prefixes *yay-*, *u-*, and *si-* do not appear to have undergone decay in Shizunai Ainu ⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--the-adjunct-reducing-prefixes-yay-u-and-si⟧.
text.ja: 再帰接頭辞 *yay-* と *si-* は屈折ではなく派生に属し、任意の動詞や位置名詞に自由に付けられるわけではない⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--the-reflexive-prefixes-yay-and-si-belong-to⟧。接頭辞 *yay-* は主要な再帰機能に加えて、再帰所有、自己使役、そして時には反使役の機能を持つ⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--the-prefix-yay-has-a-primary-reflexive-function⟧。名詞に付く *yai-* は、「ただの」、「ただひとつの」もしくは「自分だけの」、そして「自分の」という意味を表す⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--attached-to-nouns-yai-expresses-mere-ordinary-1⟧。再帰接頭辞 *yay-* と *si-* の双方は、第1類位置名詞および抱合された身体部位名詞に所有者として付加することができる⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--both-reflexive-prefixes-yay-and-si-can-attach⟧。音韻的には、*yai-ewen* の結合は *yayewen* に縮約し⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--the-combination-yai-ewen-contracts-to-yayewen⟧、*yai-omap* は *yayómap* に縮約し⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--the-combination-yai-omap-contracts-to-yay-map⟧、*yai-shitoma* は *yashtoma* と縮約する⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--the-form-yai-shitoma-contracts-to-yashtoma⟧。静内アイヌ語において、*yay-* を伴う動詞形の中には、*nu*「聞く」からの *yaynu*「思う」や *tura*「連れる」からの *yaytura*「一人でいる」のように、語源分析によってのみ再帰的起源が明らかになるほど完全に語彙化しているものがある⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--lexicalized-yay-verbs-shizunai⟧。また、静内アイヌ語において補語減少接頭辞 *yay-*、*u-*、*si-* は衰退を経験していないように見受けられる⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--the-adjunct-reducing-prefixes-yay-u-and-si⟧。

text.en: The reflexive prefix *yay-* derives the transitive verb *yay-ko-ruska* 'to be angry at oneself about something' from the ditransitive verb *ko-ruska* ⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--the-reflexive-prefix-yay-derives-the-transitive-verb⟧.
text.ja: 複他動詞 *ko-ruska* に対し、再帰接頭辞 *yay-* は他動詞 *yay-ko-ruska*「自分に対して～を怒る」を派生させる⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--the-reflexive-prefix-yay-derives-the-transitive-verb⟧。

text.en: Both *yay-* and *si-* are translated as 'oneself' and express reflexive voice, but *si-* has restrictions on the verbs it prefixes to, while *yay-* attaches relatively freely to any verb as well as to intransitive verbs and common nouns with an arity of 0 ⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--both-yay-and-si-are-translated-as-oneself⟧. Ainu thus possesses two reflexive prefixes: canonical or direct reflexive *yay-* and indirect reflexive *si-* ⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--ainu-has-two-reflexive-prefixes-canonical-or-direct⟧. The distinction between *yay-* and *si-* is analyzed as a contrast between volitional or intentional reflexivity and non-volitional or spontaneous reflexivity ⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--yay-si-volitional-vs-nonvolitional⟧, whereas another analysis treats it as an opposition between direct reflexivity, where the subject acts directly, and indirect reflexivity, where the action relies on or involves other people ⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--yay-si-direct-vs-indirect⟧. Demonstrating the volitional distinction, *yai-pusu* 'emerge' is volitional whereas *shi-pusu* expresses involuntary emergence ⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--in-contrast-to-volitional-yai-pusu-emerge-shi⟧.
text.ja: *yay-* と *si-* はともに「自分」と訳され再帰態を表すが、*si-* が接頭する動詞に制限があるのに対し、*yay-* は比較的自由にあらゆる動詞に付くほか、アリティ0として自動詞や普通名詞にも付くことができる⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--both-yay-and-si-are-translated-as-oneself⟧。アイヌ語には、典型的な直接再帰を表す *yay-* と間接再帰を表す *si-* という2つの再帰接頭辞が存在する⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--ainu-has-two-reflexive-prefixes-canonical-or-direct⟧。*yay-* と *si-* の区別については、意志的・意図的な再帰と無意志的・自発的な再帰の対立とする分析と⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--yay-si-volitional-vs-nonvolitional⟧、主語が直接手を下して行為を行う直接的再帰と他者の関与に依存する間接的再帰の対立とする分析が存在する⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--yay-si-direct-vs-indirect⟧。意志性の対立を示す例として、意志的な *yai-pusu*「出る」に対し、*shi-pusu* は無意志的な出現を表す⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--in-contrast-to-volitional-yai-pusu-emerge-shi⟧。

text.en: In Hokkaido Ainu, the reflexive prefix *yay-* functions as the equivalent of an object of the verb, whereas *yay-ko-* plays an adverbial role ⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--the-reflexive-prefix-yay-functions-as-the-equivalent⟧. The combination *yai-ko* means 'toward oneself', 'against oneself', or 'by oneself alone' ⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--the-combination-yai-ko-means-toward-oneself-against⟧. When reflexive *yay-* applies to an applicative object while the direct object is retained, the verb complex remains transitive ⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--when-reflexive-yay-applies-to-an-applicative-object⟧. Nakagawa proposes that *si-* is closer to a word-formation affix positioned closer to the root, observing that *yay-* can appear outside *si-*, as in *yay-si-turi-re* 'stretch one's body out and lie down', whereas *si-* never appears outside *yay-* ⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--there-are-examples-where-yay-appears-outside-si⟧.
text.ja: 北海道アイヌ語において、再帰接頭辞 *yay-* は動詞の目的語相当として機能するのに対し、*yay-ko-* は副詞的な役割を果たす⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--the-reflexive-prefix-yay-functions-as-the-equivalent⟧。*yai-ko* の結合は「自身に對して」、「自身に向つて」、または「自分ひとりで」を意味する⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--the-combination-yai-ko-means-toward-oneself-against⟧。直接目的語が保持されたまま再帰接頭辞 *yay-* が適用形目的語に適用される場合、動詞複合体は他動詞のままである⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--when-reflexive-yay-applies-to-an-applicative-object⟧。中川は、*yay-si-turi-re*「自分の体を伸ばして横たわる」のように *yay-* が *si-* の外側に来る例はある一方で *si-* が *yay-* の外側に来る例は見られないことから、*si-* の方が語根に近い位置にある語形成接辞に近い性質を持つと提案している⟦claim:valency/reflexive-yay--there-are-examples-where-yay-appears-outside-si⟧。
